exposure.needed: whether the environment's Argo CD actions contain empty Lua scripts

original.statement: Argo CD no longer executes empty Lua scripts in actions; empty scripts are skipped instead.

decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog title, "fix(actions): don't run empty Lua scripts" [ev-86f6b7ab4312]. It doesn't say where these scripts are configured, so no config key or resource predicate can be written. The only exposure it implies is environments whose Argo CD actions have empty Lua scripts, and no static input shown carries that. An undecidable exposure that names exactly that need is the faithful condition. Writing a concrete predicate would mean guessing from outside the evidence.
